name: elevate
whoFor: Young adults aged 18-26 in Kirklees who are not in education, employment or training and have health concerns.
locations: Brian Jackson House, 2 New North Parade, Huddersfield, HD1 5JP (elevate connect, Wednesdays 1-3.30pm)
Jo Cox House, Market Square, Batley, WF17 5DR (elevate connect, Tuesdays 1-3pm)
eligibility: Not in education, employment or training (NEET) with health concerns

projects.name: Community programme
projects.overview: Weekly group session plus weekly drop-in to build friendships, confidence, life skills and wellbeing. Activities co-designed with young people, such as yoga and gardening, arts and crafts, outings and volunteering.
projects.duration: Weekly group session, plus weekly drop-in

projects.name: Employability programme
projects.overview: One-week programmes for young people at risk of becoming NEET or unsure about career options. Mornings cover CV writing, interview preparation and job searching; afternoons have workshops and guest speakers. Breakfast, lunch and travel support provided. Key worker support and a 10 day work placement.
projects.duration: One-week programmes, running multiple times a year

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - open to referrals
